title: Where the ZIA and ZPA deployment and operations guides and leading practices guides are recorded

prose.label: ZIA.
prose.text: Authentication, bandwidth, Cloud App Control, URL filtering, DNS, firewall, IPS and Isolation are in [[shared.deployments.zia.policy-controls]]; Sandbox, Threat Protection, DLP, SaaS Security and SSL inspection are in [[shared.deployments.zia.threat-and-data]]; local breakouts and SIEM integration are in [[shared.deployments.zia.network-and-logging]]; disaster recovery is in [[shared.deployments.zia.disaster-recovery]].

prose.label: Leading practices.
prose.text: The ZIA policy guide is in [[shared.deployments.zia.policy-leading-practices]], the TLS and SSL inspection guide in [[shared.deployments.zia.tls-leading-practices]], and the ZPA guide in [[shared.deployments.zpa.leading-practices]].

prose.label: Client Connector.
prose.text: The Client Connector deployment and operations guide is recorded with the Client Connector installation subject, not here: [[zcc.install]].

prose.label: ZPA.
prose.text: App Connector, Application Discovery, Browser Access, Client Forwarding Policy, log streaming and provisioning are in [[shared.deployments.zpa.operations]]; disaster recovery is in [[shared.deployments.zpa.disaster-recovery]].
